name: routeswitch
description: macOS menu bar app that routes chosen IPs, subnets and domains through a specific network interface

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:helper: npm run build:helper:bundle && npm run build:helper:arm64 && npm run build:helper:x64 && npm run build:helper:universal
scripts.build:helper:universal: codesign --force --sign - --identifier com.routeswitch.helper build/helper/arm64/com.routeswitch.helper && codesign --force --sign - --identifier com.routeswitch.helper build/helper/x64/com.routeswitch.helper && lipo -create -output build/com.routeswitch.helper build/helper/arm64/com.routeswitch.helper build/helper/x64/com.routeswitch.helper && codesign --force --sign - --identifier com.routeswitch.helper build/com.routeswitch.helper && codesign --verify --strict --all-architectures build/com.routeswitch.helper
scripts.dist: npm run build:helper && npm run dist:app && electron-builder --projectDir build/app-stage --config ../../electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.dist:x64: npm run build:helper && npm run dist:app && electron-builder --projectDir build/app-stage --config ../../electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --x64
